title: Expresar derechos políticos: 'tener derecho a + infinitivo' y 'por medio de'

sections.content: Article 23 of the Spanish Constitution recognizes the fundamental right of citizens to participate in public affairs ('tener derecho a participar en los asuntos públicos'), either directly or through freely elected representatives ('directamente o por medio de representantes'). In Spanish electoral law, 'sufragio activo' is the right to vote, whereas 'sufragio pasivo' is the right to stand as a candidate and be elected.

items.spanish: Los ciudadanos tienen derecho a participar en los asuntos públicos por medio de representantes.
items.english: Citizens have the right to participate in public affairs through representatives.

items.spanish: El sufragio es universal, libre, igual, directo y secreto en toda España.
items.english: Suffrage is universal, free, equal, direct, and secret throughout Spain.

items.spanish: En España nadie puede ser obligado a declarar el sentido de su voto.
items.english: In Spain nobody can be forced to declare how they voted.

sections.content: For the CCSE exam, remember: voting in Spain is a constitutional right ('un derecho'), NOT a legal obligation ('no es obligatorio'), and the voting age is 18.
